paraphrase: If anyone says 'the eye is self' that is not tenable, for the arising and passing of the eye are discerned; if it were self it would follow that 'my self arises and passes away'. So for forms, eye-consciousness, contact, feeling and craving, and for all six senses.

paraphrase: Pleasant feeling left to itself brings the underlying tendency to lust, painful feeling that to aversion, neutral feeling that to ignorance; that one could make an end of suffering here and now without abandoning these is impossible; seeing thus one becomes disenchanted and is liberated.
